messages:
Marta (mktg): Quick sync — finalizing the Optimize v2 announcement. Need: changelog lines, docs link, and exact rollout timing. Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/478 . Docs preview: https://redwood.docs/release/optimize-v2-preview . Can eng lock schedule by EOD PT?

Noah (eng): Proposing canary 08:30 PT (5%), demo pin for webinar at 09:30 PT, full promote ~11:30 PT if green. Small KV-cache fix will be merged before canary.

Emily (docs): I added the CLI quickstart and a Console latency screenshot. Final docs URL will be https://redwood.docs/release/optimize-v2 by 16:00 PT. Also added a short rollback FAQ.

Priya (prod-marketing): Need benchmark hero: median at 4k context and token cost delta. Who can confirm the short sentence?

Noah (eng): Use: "~40% median latency reduction at 4k context; ~30% token cost reduction with new batching/quantization defaults." I'll paste a short blurb into the changelog.

Marta (mktg): Set alert to page #eng-oncall if error rate > 1% during the rollout. Okay?

Noah (eng): Works for us. I'll add the alert and a rollback step in the changelog (how to flip back to optimize-v1).

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by Noah at 2026-04-02T08:30:00-07:00. Notifying #eng-oncall.

Noah (eng): Canary live (5% -> optimize-v2-demo). Health checks green. Pinning demo endpoint to variant optimize-v2-demo for webinar.

Emily (docs): Uploaded final screenshot and updated quickstart. Docs URL set: https://redwood.docs/release/optimize-v2?final=1 . Redirect from /optimize -> release page added.

Priya (prod-marketing): Draft post received — swapping in docs link. I'll queue social for 12:00 PT. Need the exact benchmark phrase for the hero line.

Noah (eng): Final phrase: "~40% median latency reduction at 4k context, ~30% token cost reduction with batching + quantization." Use it verbatim.

Marta (mktg): Scheduling publish at 12:00 PT. Webinar demo will hit the canary link for attendees. If ENG wants a pause, speak now. :eyes:

Noah (eng): Promoting: 25% -> 09:50 PT, 60% -> 10:30 PT, 100% -> 11:28 PT if no regressions. Rollback command in changelog: `rwi rollback --release optimize-v2`.

deploy-bot: Promotion events queued: 25% at 2026-04-02T09:50:00-07:00, 60% at 2026-04-02T10:30:00-07:00, 100% at 2026-04-02T11:28:00-07:00.

Noah (eng): 25% cutover done, metrics stable.

Priya (prod-marketing): Publishing now in 5. Keeping lead routing: demo leads -> demo-ops inbox, enriched list to SDRs after 1h.

Noah (eng): 100% promotion complete at 11:29 PT. No error spike, latencies improved across regions.

Marta (mktg): Launch live. Post-rollout checklist: finalize changelog notes, upload press kit assets, confirm redirects, and add alert history to the runbook. We'll do a quick retro tomorrow. :tada:
